headline: As of 2026-10-14: 4,418,623 early/mail ballots cast nationally across 35 of 50 states, D+23.1 cast-ballot lean.
bullets: 4,418,623 early/mail ballots cast so far across 35 states reporting.
Across party-registration states, ballots cast lean D+23.1 by registration.
Most ballots cast: Florida (614,706), Virginia (568,467), Michigan (440,677).
